items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That was my first exposure to Earl Swope and he blew my head off, I’ve never played with a better trombone player.

ctx.x: And I guess Sonny Dunham’s was too, right?
Yeah, Sonny Dunham’s too, but that was earlier. That’s where all the Washington guys, the great Washington players, like Don Lamond, Earl Swope, Charlie Walp, those guys, Charlie wasn’t in…
